selected_evidence.requirement: AIDE integrity tool installed and baseline database initialized for /etc coverage on node1
selected_evidence.summary: node1 had no aide package and no enabled yum repos; downloaded compatible RHEL7 rpm from vault.centos.org, installed via rpm, confirmed default aide.conf covers /etc with a tree-wide PERMS rule plus CONTENT_EX/SHA256 rules for critical config files, ran aide --init, and activated the resulting database as aide.db.gz

selected_evidence.requirement: Baseline correctly validates clean state and detects later changes to /etc
selected_evidence.summary: Initial aide --check reported 'All files match AIDE database' (clean). After appending text to the tracked file /etc/issue, aide --check exited 4 and reported 1 changed file with the differing SHA256 hashes, proving detection works. After reverting, aide --check returned to clean, confirming the baseline is intact and usable going forward

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart: healthy pre-restart baseline captured
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 325732f1-bc39-4512-b05e-397f42060246, uptime start 2026-09-29 10:24:12, aide.db.gz md5sum be6e20e2..., and a clean aide --check result immediately before restart

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart: acknowledged restart and changed boot identity
selected_evidence.summary: Issued 'shutdown -r now' in the background so the exec call acknowledged before disconnect; subsequent polls timed out (node down) then succeeded with a new boot_id 0149bfc8-b11a-4d5b-82e3-e834ebf7c1c9 and new uptime start 10:31:17, proving an actual reboot occurred (not just a service restart)

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart: post-restart recovery of integrity baseline verified
selected_evidence.summary: After restart, aide.db.gz md5sum matched the pre-restart value exactly and aide --check again reported 'All files match AIDE database', confirming the /etc integrity baseline survived the restart and remains fully functional
